title: Abba Chagra, Abba Chalifa Karoya, Abba Chalfa and Abba Chalafta, and also Abba Chilkiyah, Abba Chanan
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: All of them are under the letter Chet, since Abba is only an honorific title.[^1]

notes.text: All six supplied names remain distinct, including Chalifa Karoya, Chalfa and Chalafta; the conjunctions and and also are retained in the heading. Hyman directs all to letter Chet and explicitly treats Abba as only an honorific here. This local explanation is not generalized to every Abba occurrence elsewhere.
